lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in multiple horizontal rows starting posterior to the fifth gill slit, with decreasing spot diameter towards the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated luminance intersect with the primary spots, creating a lattice-like structure on the anterior-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge (carina) is visible along the upper-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct Echeneidae individuals (remoras) attached to the body: one on the dorsal midline above the pectoral region and one on the ventral surface.
